scope: Nature meadow, source-authored Medieval Village layouts, castle courtyard and furnished watchmaker workshop; Character Create wardrobe remains unchanged.

village.duplicate: House C2 has identical local parts and is omitted
village.textures: One padded 1024-square atlas from the village and fantasy props source base-color textures
village.runtime_qualification: Visual geometry with Aethyr walker collision boxes derived from the source collision meshes and sloped stair floors; boxes approximate non-box hulls, and doors are not interactive.

collision.source: glTF (Godot) collision-only mesh nodes in the pinned village package

props.collision: visual only; existing building collision is unchanged

watchmaker_workshop.facade: Handmade static clock on the front gable; clock hands are decorative
watchmaker_workshop.stairs: Aethyr walkable ramp derived from the village sample collision

showcase.animals: Gallop clips baked to ten looping poses, in place
showcase.selection: Fantasy-appropriate food; modern packaged and fast foods omitted, with reserved layout positions.

bestiary.animation: Universal Animation Library 1: idle, walk, jog, dance, sword attack and spell casting; three seconds each

new_neighborhood.collision: walkable doorway and solid walls for each building

hostiles.behavior: Pursue the player and make timed SRD melee attacks

dungeon.layout: Three connected open-roof stone halls with five arches, columns, torches, treasure, furnishings and dungeon decorations.
dungeon.collision: Solid perimeter and interior walls with open arched passages and solid columns

scene_asset_collision.source: Generated from transformed scene vertices; narrow item gaps use bounded grouped footprints, bushes slow movement, enemies yield to the player, and trapped players recover to a clear position.

castle.foundation: Level shared castle platform with a smooth terrain transition
